test_title: PYST 59: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held  On 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

It is a cheap reasonably / restaurant in this part of the town / where you can eat / delicious food.

options.text: restaurant in this part of the town

solution:
The correct answer is** Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the third part of the given sentence, the order of adjectives is incorrect.
 
• The correct order should be: **opinion + size + age + shape + color + origin + material + purpose**.
 
• In the given sentence, **reasonably** is an **adverb** and **cheap** is an** adjective.**
 
• Therefore, the correct order should be "reasonably cheap" instead of "cheap reasonably".

 

Hence, the correct statement is: ***It is a reasonably cheap __restaurant in this part of the town where you can eat delicious food*.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The **order of adjectives **is crucial for the sentence to make sense and sound natural.
 
• **Adverbs usually modify adjectives, verbs, or other adverbs,** and should be placed in the correct order to maintain the intended meaning of the sentence.
